'''Kett''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who served as a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] operator aboard the [[Rebel privateer]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Free Lance]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point during the conflict, Kett monitored the ship's sensors during an attack on the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Indupar Nova]]'' in the [[Ec Pand system/Legends|Ec Pand system]].
